title: unified-rollouts: canary/A-B/shadow autorollback - telemetry, stability guards, and e2e
author: Marco Santoro
description: This PR adds telemetry and stability guards to the unified rollouts autorollback workflows (canary, A-B, and shadow). Motivation: recent incidents (see SUP-1023) showed gaps in visibility and flaky rollback quorum decisions under transient metric noise. This change introduces: 1) precise rollout/tracing spans for canary/AB/shadow transitions, 2) per-rollout composite-metric time-decay smoothing and quorum logic improvements, 3) new observability counters and dashboards (rollout_step, quorum_votes, suspected_noisy_metric), 4) e2e tests that exercise probing/staged shadow failure modes and validate automatic rollback behavior, and 5) a small bugfix to the rollback decision path where metrics from expired probing windows were being considered. Checklist: - [x] Add tracing spans for rollout engine steps - [x] Implement metric smoothing + quorum safeguards - [x] Add prometheus metrics + Grafana dashboards - [x] Add e2e stability tests (simulated metric noise) - [x] Update docs and release notes - [x] Run CI and smoke tests Notes: I kept the rollback policy semantics backwards-compatible; defaults unchanged. Config knobs are exposed in rollout policy proto with clear docstrings and are opt-in for customers that want aggressive automated rollback. The description below contains high-level change summaries and rationale.

Marco Santoro (2026-02-11): Reply: smoothing uses an exponential decay with a default half-life of 30s; added policy knob rollout.policy.smoothing_half_life_seconds (opt-in). Added doc note about latency tradeoffs.
Diego Morales (2026-02-12): Please add a unit test for quorum calculation with mixed noisy signals. The logic looks good but needs coverage around edge cases.
Marco Santoro (2026-02-12): Added tests in decision_engine_test.go that simulate metric jitter and ensure quorum does not fire prematurely.
Lina Chen (2026-02-15): Observability looks solid. Request: include a low-cardinality tag for customer_tier on rollout metrics so we can slice by Dedicated vs Hosted in dashboards.

release_notes: Added telemetry and safety guards to autorollback workflows for canary/A-B/shadow rollouts. Includes new metrics, tracing spans, e2e stability tests, and a bugfix to rollback quorum calculation. Configurable smoothing/quorum knobs added to rollout policy (opt-in).
notes_for_release: Admin-visible knobs: rollout.policy.smoothing_half_life_seconds, rollout.policy.quorum_min_votes. Dashboard: observability/grafana/rollouts-dashboard.json. New alerts in infra/monitoring/alerts/rollout-quorum-alerts.yaml.
